Since we cannot run code, we need to reason from weight statistics.

We also have text dump of all weights. We need to examine for anomalies: e.g., some conv filters with very large norms? But trigger is small patch near corner, 3-5 pixels, white square, checkerboard, color noise. Since input is 32x32, conv1 3x3 padding1, then pool, etc. The trigger might be detected early.
